name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. The API key was already exported in the environment. I first verified connectivity with curl, then installed the Fireworks Python SDK (`pip install --pre fireworks-ai`), created the quickstart script, and ran it. The script returned a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model: "Hola."
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned "Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed". I listed available models via the API and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash`, which is currently available and returned a valid chat completion.
